translations.sourceText: Dive into Recursion's innovative approach to decoding biology. Join our mission & explore what AI drug discovery companies can do. Contact us today!
translations.translationCn: 深入了解 Recursion 解码生物学的创新方法。加入我们的使命，探索人工智能药物发现公司能够做什么。立即联系我们！

translations.sourceText: From this platform, the company plans to drive future innovation across its pipeline of cutting-edge cell therapy modalities.
translations.translationCn: 公司计划以该平台为基础，推动其前沿细胞治疗技术管线的未来创新。

translations.sourceText: Guardant Health is a leading precision medicine company focused on transforming patient care and conquering cancer with data.
translations.translationCn: Guardant Health 是一家领先的精准医疗公司，专注于利用数据改变患者诊疗并应对癌症。

translations.sourceText: Legend Biotech is a global, commercial-stage biotechnology company developing and manufacturing novel therapies. We explore and apply innovative technologies to deliver cutting-edge options for patients around the world.
translations.translationCn: Legend Biotech 是一家处于商业化阶段的全球生物技术公司，开发和生产创新疗法。公司探索并应用创新技术，为全球患者提供前沿治疗选择。

translations.sourceText: Track the development of Moderna’s mRNA medicines. From preclinical development to commercial phase.
translations.translationCn: 追踪 Moderna 的 mRNA 药物从临床前开发到商业化阶段的进展。

translations.sourceText: Our pipeline of cell therapies is made up of novel agents and innovative technologies in personalized medicine.
translations.translationCn: 公司的细胞治疗管线由个性化医疗领域的创新药物和创新技术组成。

translations.sourceText: Learn how we strive to deliver long-term value to our shareholders.
translations.translationCn: 了解公司如何努力为股东创造长期价值。

translations.sourceText: Learn how we’re changing the world of medicine. Discover career opportunities, our product pipeline, and browse media resources. Meet Moderna.
translations.translationCn: 了解 Moderna 如何改变医学世界。查看职业机会、产品管线和媒体资料，并进一步认识 Moderna。

translations.sourceText: Explore Recursion's dynamic drug discovery pipeline. Witness the innovations and breakthroughs in our journey. Dive deeper with us today!
translations.translationCn: 探索 Recursion 持续发展的药物发现管线，了解其发展历程中的创新与突破，并进一步深入了解公司。

translations.sourceText: Guardant Complete, a comprehensive portfolio of liquid and tissue precision oncology tests combined with best-in-class customer service.
translations.translationCn: Guardant Complete 是一套综合性的液体和组织精准肿瘤检测产品组合，并配套一流的客户服务。

translations.sourceText: Stay informed with Guardant Health's Investor Relations. Access financial reports, upcoming events, and key updates on our mission.
translations.translationCn: 通过 Guardant Health 投资者关系页面获取财务报告、近期活动和公司使命相关的重要更新。

translations.sourceText: CASGEVY™ (exagamglogene autotemcel), a CRISPR/Cas9 gene-edited therapy arising out of our collaboration with Vertex Pharmaceuticals Incorporated, is approved in some countries for certain eligible patients with sickle cell disease or transfusion-dependent beta thalassemia.
translations.translationCn: CASGEVY™（exagamglogene autotemcel）是一种源于公司与 Vertex Pharmaceuticals Incorporated 合作的 CRISPR/Cas9 基因编辑疗法；该疗法已在部分国家获批，用于某些符合条件的镰状细胞病或输血依赖型 β 地中海贫血患者。

translations.sourceText: The Investor Relations website contains information about CRISPR Therapeutics's business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
translations.translationCn: CRISPR Therapeutics 投资者关系网站面向股东、潜在投资者和金融分析师提供公司业务信息。

translations.sourceText: Description: Autologous, ex vivo CRISPR/Cas9 gene-edited therapy in which aims to edit a patient’s own hematopoietic stem cells to produce fetal hemoglobin in red blood cells.
translations.translationCn: 描述：一种自体、体外 CRISPR/Cas9 基因编辑疗法，旨在编辑患者自身的造血干细胞，使红细胞产生胎儿血红蛋白。

translations.sourceText: Deliver the greatest possible impact to people through mRNA medicines.
translations.translationCn: 通过 mRNA 药物为人们带来尽可能大的积极影响。

translations.sourceText: The Investor Relations website contains information about Recursion Pharmaceuticals, Inc.'s business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
translations.translationCn: Recursion Pharmaceuticals, Inc. 投资者关系网站面向股东、潜在投资者和金融分析师提供公司业务信息。
